Production refuses the process-local store (app/api/connectors.py:139-158), and the API, the worker (app/scaling/tasks.py:2462-2474) and publish_mission (1519-1529) all resolve through the tenant-aware resolver. The only durable copy is still in Redis, and the minor gaps remain.

OAuth GET callback still writes vault-encrypted _encrypted_access_token/_encrypted_refresh_token into the Redis auth_config, which nothing reads (app/api/connectors.py:1480-1500)

new_defects: app/providers/vault.py:377-400 + app/api/connectors.py:1481 — get_vault() is uncached and runs PBKDF2-HMAC 480k iterations (about 0.3 s CPU) on each call. app/providers/vault.py:207-306 — rotate_key swaps the Fernet only in the calling process and skips secrets it cannot decrypt. features.evidence: No commits touched app/api/a2a.py, agent_directory.py or the a2a_tasks migration since the baseline (a4d172588..HEAD). The honest parts hold: tasks run as the authenticated caller, signatures are timestamped and single-use (Redis SET NX, fail-closed 503), inbound is refused in production without a secret, and callbacks are re-validated and IP-pinned. But execution is still a fire-and-forget task on the API replica, callbacks are unsigned, context is dropped, and a hard 300s watcher timeout permanently records long goals as 'timeout'.
still_open: Fire-and-forget execution: execute_and_callback (submit_goal + outcome watch) is asyncio.create_task on the API replica; a restart or deploy leaves the a2a_tasks row 'accepted' forever with no callback, and nothing reconciles it (app/api/a2a.py:396-414)
Per-agent directory is still an honest 501 (app/api/agent_directory.py:26-37)
Callback POST is unsigned (no HMAC/timestamp header), so the receiver cannot authenticate it (app/api/a2a.py:290-299)
Agent card advertises only X-A2A-Signature, not X-A2A-Timestamp or the '{ts}.'+body signing base, so a spec-following client gets 401 (app/api/a2a.py:322-326 vs 142-151)
A2ATaskRequest.context is accepted but never passed to submit_goal (execution_context not set) (app/api/a2a.py:307, 398-403)

Synchronous assert_public_url (blocking DNS) called inside async handlers stalls the event loop on slow resolvers (app/api/a2a.py:285, 369) [low]
